title: Pedaiah
summary: Redemption of the Lord. (1.) The father of Zebudah, who was the wife of Josiah and mother of king Jehoiakim (2 Kings 23:36).

inlines.v: Redemption of the Lord. (1.) The father of Zebudah, who was the wife of Josiah and mother of king Jehoiakim (2 Kings 23:36).
(3.). The father of Joel, ruler of the half-tribe of Manasseh (1 Chr. 27:20).
